card.line: Tarsus was a well-known city in Cilicia and the hometown of Saul, who became the apostle Paul, and it is where he was sent and later sought out.

moments.title: Saul is sent off to Tarsus
moments.text: After the Greek-speaking Jews try to kill Saul, the brothers take him down to Caesarea. From there they send him off to Tarsus.

moments.title: Barnabas looks for Saul
moments.text: Barnabas goes to Tarsus to look for Saul. When he finds him, he brings him back to Antioch, and they teach large numbers of people there.
